rationale: After 39 minutes in the trade and with only 15 minutes remaining in the session, the short breakdown has stalled around $20.70 and failed to gain downside follow-through despite the broader market being down 3.58%. The most recent 1-minute candle shows a sharp volume expansion (87.4k shares) pushing price back up into the 5-minute 9-EMA ($20.78), signaling buyer absorption and late-day short covering. Closing now locks in a small profit and avoids risking a squeeze back above entry into the market close.
